guidebook.intro: Gaana mu Lungereza: saagala, simanyi, sirina, era olagire omuntu aleme okukola ekintu.

tips.title: “I don’t …”
body: Mu Lusoga otandika n’**si-**: **saagala**, **sirya**. Mu Lungereza oteeka **don’t** mu maaso g’ekikolwa: **I don’t want. I don’t eat. I don’t know.**
Ku kiragiro, **Don’t** kitandika: **Don’t go! Don’t be afraid.**

tips.title: “I don’t have” ne “there is no”
body: **Sirina** kiba **I don’t have**: **I don’t have money.** **Tewali** kiba **there is no** oba **there isn’t**: **There is no water.**

tips.title: He doesn’t, she isn’t
body: Ku **he**, **she** ne **it** kozesa **doesn’t**: **He doesn’t eat meat.** Ku kikolwa ekikolebwa atyanu, kozesa **isn’t**: **Nakato isn’t going to school today.**

culture.title: Okugaana mu bukakamu
body: Mu Lungereza **No** yoka eyinza okuwulikika ng’ekakali. Yongerako **thank you**: **No, thank you.** Oba gamba **Not now, maybe tomorrow.**
